brihadisvara-temple-thanjavur.title: Chola Lost-Wax Bronze Nataraja
brihadisvara-temple-thanjavur.periodAndMaterial: 11th Century CE • Panchaloha Alloy • Thanjavur Epigraphical Collection
brihadisvara-temple-thanjavur.provenance: Imperial Chola Dynasty (1010 CE). Cast via cire-perdue (lost-wax) casting in five-metal panchaloha alloy. Dedicated under Emperor Rajaraja Chola I at Peruvudaiyar Koyil (Brihadisvara), Thanjavur.
brihadisvara-temple-thanjavur.institution: Archaeological Survey of India (ASI) / Thanjavur Palace Epigraphical Archive

hotspots.name: damaru
hotspots.label: Damaru (Cosmic Sound)
hotspots.description: Upper right hand holds the hourglass drum, whose rhythmic beat resonates the primordial vibration (nada) that generates the cosmos.

hotspots.name: agni
hotspots.label: Agni (Cosmic Fire)
hotspots.description: Upper left hand cradles the transformative cosmic flame, symbolizing the destruction of illusions and cycle of renewal.

hotspots.name: abhaya
hotspots.label: Abhaya Mudra (Protection)
hotspots.description: Lower right hand displays the gesture of fearlessness and divine protection for spiritual seekers.

hotspots.name: apasmara
hotspots.label: Apasmara Purusha
hotspots.description: The demonic dwarf of spiritual ignorance, forgetfulness, and delusion crushed under Shiva's grounded right foot.

hotspots.name: prabha-mandala
hotspots.label: Tiruvasi (Aura of Flames)
hotspots.description: Circular flaming aureole represents the macroscopic cosmic cycle of space-time and universal consciousness.

konark-sun-temple.title: Konark Chariot Sun Dial Wheel
konark-sun-temple.periodAndMaterial: 13th Century CE • Chlorite Stone • Eastern Ganga Dynasty
konark-sun-temple.provenance: Commissioned by King Narasimhadeva I of the Eastern Ganga Dynasty (1250 CE). Serves as an astronomical sundial calculating solar time with shadow spokes.

hotspots.name: axle-hub
hotspots.label: Central Hub Sundial Axis
hotspots.description: The shadow cast by the central axle pin calculates the precise prahar (3-hour solar interval) of the day.

hotspots.name: carved-spokes
hotspots.label: Eight Major Spokes
hotspots.description: Representing the eight prahars of the day, adorned with celestial musicians, dancers, and royal hunting scenes.

default.title: Carved Granite Temple Stele
default.periodAndMaterial: 11th – 12th Century CE • Monolithic Granite • South Indian Epigraphical Archive
default.provenance: High-relief architectural stele documenting medieval temple mandapa carving traditions. Preserved in national archaeological archives.

hotspots.name: iconography
hotspots.label: Monolithic Bas-Relief
hotspots.description: Precision chisel carving into hard plutonic granite, retaining crisp iconographic outlines after nine centuries.

hotspots.name: patina
hotspots.label: Archaeological Mineral Patina
hotspots.description: Surface minerals and ceremonial ablution patination confirming historical antiquity and preservation grade.
